## Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta6

### Added
- Visual Editor Schedule view selection: Automatic, Navimower or Native.
- Navimower Schedule can be opened while disabled so Custom order can be prepared without starting mowing.
- Custom queue editing with reorder, repeat and remove controls using `navimower.set_schedule_queue`.
- Direct Settings dialog controls for switch, select, number and time entities; other/read-only entities retain More Info.
